Light-diffusing systems shall comply with Sections 2606.7.1 through 2606.7.5. Light-diffusing systems shall not be installed in the following occupancies and locations:
   1.   Any room in which the net floor area per occupant is 20 square feet (1.86 m 2 ) or less, or any room leading there from through which it is necessary for occupants to pass in order to reach the only exit.
   2.   Group I-2.
   3.   Group I-3.
   4.   Interior exit stairways, ramps and exit passageways.
